critical_code_review_comments: IcsFiscalDocument.jsx line 78: buyer_tin filter uses `GENERAL_PUBLIC_TIN.includes(applied.buyer_tin)` — since every row has the same pinned buyer TIN, filtering by buyer TIN is effectively binary (matches all or none). Acceptable given the current General-Public data model, but confusing UX.

Line 187: Export QR button opens the confirmation dialog and triggers download in the same click. If the user cancels the browser download prompt, the dialog still reports 'N QR entries downloaded' — cosmetic wording issue.

exportCsv/exportQr use `_uuid` synthesized from row.id when government payload is missing (line 70-71). Downstream consumers should not treat these as real LHDN UUIDs — consider labelling the CSV column 'E-Invoice UUID (or synthesized)' or gating export until a real government UUID exists.
Filter panel has no Status field even though the query still sends `status` when applied.status !== 'all' — dead code path (status is never mutated from UI). Remove or wire a Status filter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice Management page renders 70 rows from /api/ics/transactions with client-side synthesized doc_no, submission_uid, and uuid. Buyer info is hard-pinned to General Public / EI00000000010. All data-testids listed in the review (im-expand, im-search, im-cancel/view/pdf/share/reasons/log/export/export-qr, im-select-all, im-row-<id>, im-select-<id>) are wired.
